_doc: Served-file overrides built by tools/build_overrides.py into server/deploy/overrides/ (gitignored). sgtext_en: the version suffix of the patched UI text table (data/sgtext_en_patch.csv on top of the archive's sgtext_en_<base>); F_RESOURCE_MST: the version of the re-encoded resource table that lists it (also written to deploy/system/version_info.json).
_phase: tools/build_phase.py: cutoff = last month (YYYY-MM) of data/*_timeline.json first_seen that is in; bump = added to the archive's version of every filtered table (raise it whenever the filter output changes, so clients re-download).
